name: Whatsapp Bubble
description: Displays a floating whatsapp call link.
project_description: Whatsapp Bubble adds a floating WhatsApp contact bubble to a Drupal site: a fixed-position link that opens a wa.me chat with an admin-configured phone number and optional prefilled message. It can inject the bubble site-wide on non-admin pages via a config flag, or be placed as one of two block plugins (a floating bubble and a labelled button). The button block supports a per-block phone-number override so different sections can point at different numbers. All variants share one theme layer (templates and a CSS library) and are styled by alignment (left/right/center, top/middle/bottom) and an optional inverse color scheme. No dependencies beyond Drupal core 10/11; no third-party script is loaded.
